title: Design FMEA draft: 2040-CNV-202 head drive unit
method: Ratings 1 to 10 (10 worst, detection 10 = hard to detect). RPN = S x O x D is used for ranking only. Rows with S of 9 or more are flagged regardless of RPN, in the spirit of the AIAG-VDA 2019 handbook that puts severity first. The Action Priority lookup table is not reproduced here.
ratingsOwner: Draft ratings by the author for a synthetic twin. A cross-functional team must re-rate them with plant data.
detectionNote: D_now assumes operator rounds and a trip as the only controls. D_twin assumes the stop-rate detector (v6) and a vibration transmitter are live. Rows this system cannot see keep the same D.

rows.effect: Rising vibration and noise, then seizure and an unplanned stop of hours
rows.cause: Cyclic load, marginal lubrication, installation damage
rows.signal: Stop rate trend, vibration, BPFO and harmonics
rows.action: Plan replacement on trend-confirmed alert; keep a spare block in stores

rows.cause: Missed regreasing, wrong grease, washdown flushing
rows.action: Condition-based regrease with ultrasonic or temperature check
Sealed or stainless units; add a second transmitter point

rows.part: Head shaft and pillow block alignment
rows.effect: Edge loading, heat, early bearing failure
rows.action: Laser or string alignment record at every replacement
Oil analysis interval; add motor current monitoring (not modelled)

rows.cause: Overload, poor cooling, contamination of fan cover
rows.action: Thermography round; keep cooling path clear

rows.cause: Frame skew, drum crowning wear, uneven load
rows.action: Tracking inspection triggered by stop-rate advisory
Torque-stripe marks, check at each regreasing

rows.cause: Loose stud, cable damage, calibration drift
rows.action: Stud mounting, annual verification against a handheld meter

rows.effect: Phantom micro-stops inflate the stop rate
rows.signal: Rate jump with no mechanical symptom

rows.mode: Guard removed or open during running
rows.effect: Entanglement or crushing injury at the drum nip
rows.cause: Guard removed for clearing jams, no interlock
rows.action: Interlocked guard and lockout before any jam clearing
